conflicts.description: T23 (#34 / paused PR38), T24 and plan validation (#43 / paused PR44) overlap future dispatcher responsibilities. README is shared with paused PRs.
conflicts.resolution: Design PR changes only proposed design and README entry. T23 owns current handoff/policy evaluation and notification; T24 owns current polling/fix loops. Off/shadow retain those authorities, shadow cannot launch/post. Active requires a separate owner-approved canonical migration PR for pr-review-loop, operations and T23/T24 ledger: delegate one evaluator/notifier to Issue45, retain T23 CI-policy protection, disable only migrated T24/old runner jobs after verified shutdown. No paused PR38/44 code is imported or work resumed. Implementation supplies a default-off adapter against merged-main APIs and migration checks, never a competing active judge.

assessments.reason: Keep keys, tokens, private paths, AI transcripts and dispatcher storage outside public artifacts. Reuse reviewed-main App credential tooling only.

checks.method: Inspect every public diff and run the staged publication checker. Trace webhook/AI credential boundaries against PR42-R001/R006.
checks.expected: No credentials/personal paths; scoped identity and failed/unknown authorization deny execution. PR content never becomes trusted startup code.

checks.method: Trace dispatch-read batch token with empty gh config, one receive App, identity-bound review/fix/notification brokers, worker result provenance and OS/tool isolation. Review PR42-R001/R004/R006 across all routes.
checks.expected: Missing token stops before gh; no administrator/other-App fallback. Reviewer output cannot select keys or authors. Worker tools cannot read keychains/credentials/policy/DB or use network; unsupported isolation denies launch. Live CLI and OS proofs remain implementation/rollout tests.

assessments.reason: Propose a design, not an operational migration. Same Codex owns design/implementation; Claude reviews design first. Owner clarified: Issue45 completion is implementation/verification/independent review of default-off infrastructure; production installation and live AI/webhook validation are deferred until owner configuration. Other reviews may resume after infrastructure completion.

checks.method: Compare Issue45 with main T23/T24 scope and paused PR38/44 metadata. Compare hosting options and actual CLI capabilities.
checks.expected: No dependency on unmerged code or implicit desktop launch API. Implementation/configuration steps and unavailable capabilities are explicit.

checks.method: Read README link, design status, Issue45 and current PR protocol together.
checks.expected: Design remains proposed; existing readiness/merge rules apply to this PR; only final implementation PR closes Issue45; no paused PR resumes.

checks.method: Compare off/shadow/active readiness, acceptance, Copilot/faultfinding, notification and T23/T24 ownership; keep canonical migration an explicit activation prerequisite.
checks.expected: Existing handoff/COMMENT acceptance works unchanged off/shadow; active native protocol never overrides main via a prompt. No double notifier or automatic resumption/activation. O1-O3 are deferred deployment decisions, not design acceptance gates.

assessments.reason: Preserve independence, exact head/base and all existing merge conditions while proposing native reviews and deterministic routing.

checks.method: Trace duplicate/out-of-order events, process crash, uncertain launch/post, generation changes, global capacity, pause and rollback through state model and acceptance matrix.
checks.expected: No live worker stolen by timeout; no auto-retry of uncertain side effect; no self-post loop; stable finding IDs and regressions remain visible.

checks.method: Trace human/AI readiness and approval, push/base invalidation, forged events, failed pagination and unsafe worker startup.
checks.expected: Standard human operations suffice; native approval is bound to verified current pair/actor; fail closed on unknown evidence; broker posts only independently validated results and has no autonomous merge authority.

checks.method: PR46-D001/D002: enumerate operation authorization, authenticated event actor, current main-tip ancestor proof, server event/history ordering, immutable consumed IDs, initial non-Draft creation and reconcile recovery. Test replay after pause/TTL, wrong Ready actor and incomplete history.
checks.expected: Only implementer/owner may establish Ready; only owner resumes. No payload or author-controlled commit date proves freshness; unknown exact-pair binding requires new standard Ready. Consumed IDs survive payload deletion.

checks.method: PR46-D005-D009: trace identity/run/result-hash binding, daemon singleton, per-PR lease across kinds/generations, separate run supervisor/process group, crash reconnect, unknown POST, notification dedup and ID-independent quotas.
checks.expected: No self/push approval, stale/wrong-identity result, second live job or uncertain re-post. No conversational resume. Auto-fix default off; maximum 2 fixes per owner authorization and 6 AI review/faultfinding starts in rolling 24h, persisted before launch. Limits pause for owner; notices never start workers.

checks.method: Carry PR46-I001-I007 into implementation acceptance: CLI/version/schema/auth, SQLite, HTTP/delivery, pagination/rate/shadow latency, retarget/test-merge, all nine counterexamples, trusted-version self-change boundary.
